tuning.blurb: They are not here for the county. They are here for the barn.

lines.incoming: A convoy of unmarked vans has parked at the end of your drive. Nobody has got out yet.
lines.levied: The Compliance Task Force served papers, took ${price} and left with {stock}. Everyone was very polite about it.
lines.levied_nostock: The Compliance Task Force served papers and left with ${price}. Everyone was very polite about it.
lines.repelled: The Compliance Task Force has been escorted off the property by something with four heads. Notoriety down; paperwork pending.
lines.capped: You are now as wanted as it is possible to be. Further notoriety would be redundant, and the neighbours have run out of adjectives.
